response.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, CAST(feature_count AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM site_totals), compared AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is across site codes with at least one non-NULL feature count.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every code in sites, assigning zero features to sites with no recorded count when calculating the average share.
alternatives.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, COALESCE(SUM(f.traitcount), 0) AS feature_count FROM sites AS s LEFT JOIN scanfeatures AS f ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry AND f.traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, CAST(feature_count AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM site_totals), compared AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10
